APEC Summit 2026: Trump called his Thursday summit with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin a “win” even before it began, as China rolled out a lavish, pageantry-filled welcome. Analysts doubt the unprecedented meeting of the three largest nuclear powers will yield major agreements, while smaller nations worry their interests could be overlooked.
